description: Source code implementing a URI dispatcher using a trie data structure for handling REST API paths with support for wildcard variables and directives.

methods.name: uriDispatcherCreate
methods.description: Creates and initializes a new URI dispatcher with an empty trie and directive map.

methods.name: uriDispatcherDestroy
methods.description: Recursively destroys the URI dispatcher and all associated nodes and directives.

methods.name: registerUriHandler
methods.description: Registers a handler callback for a specific URI template, supporting wildcards and directives.

methods.name: locateUriHandler
methods.description: Finds and returns the handler for a given URI, extracting variable values into a map.

methods.name: uriHandlerContainerDestroy
methods.description: Frees memory allocated for a URI handler container.

methods.name: uriDispatcherRegisterDirective
methods.description: Registers a custom directive with a handler for variable processing.
